_comment: Budgets for npm run perf (milliseconds; headless Chromium, 1280x720 at deviceScaleFactor 2; see tests/perf/check.mjs for the configurations). titlePainted = navigation start to the title on screen (two animation frames after it is shown, or its largest-contentful-paint if later: a cold first visit shows it still, as plain SVG, while its bitmaps are painted); titleLive = the title animating with all its bitmaps; frameP95 = 95th percentile rAF interval on the animated title (16.7 = 60 fps); rasterMsPerFrame = tile raster on the worker threads per frame on the idle title (from a trace); maxLongTaskPlay = longest main-thread task while playing potty and teeth on the real clock with the auto-player (--play), outside AT.go transitions; playFrameP95 = the worst played scene's rAF p95; transitionMax = slowest AT.go to fully faded in, over hub, potty, teeth, baby, tv and party (each scene's own limit under scenes: 2.5 s, potty 3.5 s: its manifest, the hand-washing close-up included, is painted behind its cover); sceneFrameP95 = the worst scene's rAF p95 just after it is shown. revisit*: the second load in the same profile, bitmaps from IndexedDB.

stretch._comment: Printed, never fails. titleShown on a cold visit is reached by the still preview (titlePainted and titleLive are the cold load budgets). maxLongTask = the longest main-thread task anywhere, loading included; maxLongTaskIdle = the longest task in idle frames (the title and freshly entered scenes, nobody playing).
